objective_for_doctor:
Age: 9
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have a cough, is your nose or the back of your throat itchy, and severe itching in one or both eyes

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Hi. I have a cough, and my nose or the back of my throat feels itchy. Also my eyes really itch, in one or both eyes.
Do you have any fever or chills, or has your temperature been normal?
No fever or chills. I think my temperature has been normal.
Are you having any shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness?
No, I’m not having shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness.
Is the cough dry or are you bringing up any mucus/phlegm (and if so, what color)?
It’s mostly a dry cough. I’m not bringing up mucus or phlegm.
Do you have any sore throat, hoarseness, or a sensation of something stuck in your throat?
Yes, my throat feels itchy, but I don’t have sore throat or hoarseness. I don’t feel like something is stuck in my throat.
Do you have any nasal congestion, runny nose, or sneezing?
Not really congested. I don’t have a runny nose or sneezing—I mostly just feel the itching in my nose and the back of my throat.
Are you having itchy skin, hives, swelling of lips/face, or any vomiting/diarrhea?
No itchy skin or hives. No swelling of my lips or face. No vomiting or diarrhea.
Do you have any known allergies (seasonal/environmental/food/medications), or have you been exposed recently to something new (pollen, dust, pets, smoke, new detergent)?
Yes, I’m more likely to get common allergies than other kids. I haven’t been around any new things that I know of—no new pets, smoke, or new detergent.
Do you notice symptoms are worse at certain times (e.g., outdoors, at night, in a specific room), or during a particular season?
I think it’s worse when I’m around outside air in the city, and it can be worse at certain times of day, but I’m not sure about a specific season.
Do you have any eye redness, discharge, or crusting of the eyelids?
No eye redness or discharge. No crusting on my eyelids—just severe itching.
Have you had any recent sick contacts or symptoms like fever, body aches, or sore throat from an infection?
No sick contacts. No fever or body aches. Just the itchy nose/throat and the dry cough.

[ABSTAIN] I don’t yet have enough discriminating information to confidently narrow to a single diagnosis (itching eyes/nose with dry cough could fit allergic causes, but we still need key details like wheeze, timing/seasonality, and any nasal symptoms).  
[POSSIBLE] Allergic sinusitis, Acute laryngitis, URTI, Bronchitis, Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation
